mission.title: Network Tampering
mission.description: Escort a Zion Hacker to crack into a Machine network.
mission.neighbourhoods: Achan, Camon Heights, Eshean Projects, Mara, Midian Park, Moriah Projects, Tabor Park

phase.briefing:
Checksum needs help cracking some data that he's uncovered deep within a Matrix Network. The only operative that can hack into this data is Mizar and her communication link with the hovercraft seems to be down right now.
Find Mizar and escort her to Checksum so we can take advantage of this weak point before it is fixed.

enter.say: Mizar isn't expecting you because of the broken communication link.

objective.text: Lead Mizar out of the area

phase.briefing: That's an excellent start, {player}. Ensure that Mizar reaches Checksum safely. You have her coordinates -- go there now.

enter.say: I think Checksum is still trying to hack through the Machine Network. He'll be glad to see you and Mizar.
